$comment: Next.js needs a tsconfig at the app root. The authoritative typecheck is
the ROOT `pnpm tsc --noEmit`, which covers this directory as part of one
program — see /tsconfig.json. This file exists so `next dev`, `next build`
and the editor resolve the same way, and it must not drift from the root.
tsconfig.contract.test.ts asserts that it does not.
